items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for the two isolated LCP candidates; blocked for go-live, monetization expansion, analytics activation, or production admission where existing measurement windows prohibit queueing. Recommendation: retain both candidates deferred and do not create or admit change requests this cycle. Evidence: aliencouncil.com mobile LCP 3501ms and newmomshop.com mobile LCP 3599ms from the 2026-10-03 web-vitals snapshot; authoritative queue state shows active measurement blockers, with newmomshop.com also in an active pilot measurement. Legal does not block ordinary reversible growth merely because analytics coverage is incomplete, but no claims of revenue, ROI, attribution, causal lift, or compliance certification are supported. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 38 pass, 22 fail, 1 unknown; site-specific launch clearance is not evidenced. Data quality has red analytics coverage with 0 of 38 expected sites observed, and operations/fleet-doctor evidence is unavailable. Exact decision: keep both LCP fixes deferred, avoid duplicate requests, and reassess after each site’s measurement blocker clears using the recorded baseline, focused build/link/accessibility/performance evidence, isolated rollback, and existing measurement boundary. Human counsel is not required for these ordinary performance fixes unless scope changes to new tracking, data collection, monetization, claims, or regulated/age-sensitive functionality. Launch-readiness remains active and no go-live decision is supported.

Launch-readiness progress: 0 of 4 SearchWoot legal tasks are evidenced complete; close none. The four open tasks remain source rights/data-use limits, alert-data flow and retention, GA4 consent/configuration, and logs/vendors/incident handling. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering backend/api/main.py, backend/services/fetcher.py, config.yml, privacy.html, cookie-policy.html, terms.html, and available vendor/configuration records, with field inventory, retention/deletion/correction/access behavior, consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 settings, vendor/DPA status, incident/request handling, and exact unknowns. Prepare but do not send any upstream permission request pending owner authorization and human counsel review.

SearchWoot data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked because current terms do not establish public redistribution, storage, historical derivatives, display, caching, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; smallest next action is obtain and attach a current written permission or API agreement plus field-level terms. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed because data inventory, retention, deletion/correction, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced; smallest next action is complete the read-only data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed because deployed consent behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced; smallest next action is capture current consent/configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed because log fields, retention/access controls, vendor terms/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures are not evidenced; smallest next action is complete the operator/vendor inventory. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, privacy/jurisdiction treatment, and any affiliate or advertising use.
